ja: • 連合宇宙艦隊の中核をなすムラサメ型宇宙巡洋艦がメカコレに登場。
• 「ムラサメ」と「ユウギリ」の艦名表示シール付属。
• 別売りの「メカコレNo.2 ユキカゼ」「メカコレNo.10 キリシマ」とともに、メカコレで「メ号作戦」の連合宇宙艦隊を再現できる。
成形品×4、テトロンシール×1、組立説明書（箱裏に印刷）
en: • The Murasame-class space cruiser, which forms the core of the United Starfleet, appears in the mechanical collection.
• Ship name display seals for "Murasame" and "Yugiri" are included.
• Together with "Mechacolle No. 2 Yukikaze" and "Mechacolle No. 10 Kirishima" (sold separately), you can recreate the combined space fleet of "Operation Me" with the mechacolle.
Molded product x 4, Tetron Seal x 1, assembly manual (printed on the back of the box)
